Name: Nyapu style Shopkeeper Leela
Author: DizzyMermaid
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]I couldn't leave Leela behind in my latest playthrough where I was using Nyapu's portraits, so I made a version of her for myself and thought I'd share it! She's not perfect (also her original portrait is literally the sweetest???) but I hope others enjoy her. (And also if someone out there can do a better Nyapu version, PLEASE let me know!)[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]This is not a Content Patcher mod! It will replace Leela's portraits.

Simply download the mod, extract the files, and pop it into your [CP] Shopkeeper Leela - Pierre's Competition in your mods folder - you will be prompted to replace 2 files, which will overwrite Leela's portraits.[/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]The original mod, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39490]Shopkeeper Leela - Pierre's Competition.[/url][/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
Thanks to yuninocorn, the creator of Leela, for making an awesome mod and letting me share this version of her!
And of course the biggest credit to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/nyapu]Nyapu[/url] for their fantastic art and permission to use their assets.
